what: The top 1,000 DOT holders on Polkadot Asset Hub by free+reserved, as one dated cohort. Supersedes cohort 2026-08-21, whose Subscan capture silently lost ranks 1-10: their medal-styled rows lack the rank-badge markup the parser keyed on, so that cohort was ranks 11-1000 and its description claimed otherwise. Rank is now derived from row position and cross-checked against the badge where present.
